title: Optimal power concavity of the variational mean curvature via singular $1$-Laplace problems
summary: Let $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^N$ be a bounded convex domain and let $H_Ω\leq 0$ denote its variational mean curvature, in the sense of Barozzi, Gonzalez and Tamanini [PAMS, 1987]. We prove that $-H_Ω$ is harmonic convex, that is $1/H_Ω$ is a convex function in $Ω$, and that the exponent $-1$ is optimal in the class of convex domains. This strictly improves the concavity of $H_Ω$ obtained by Alter and Caselles [Nonlinear Anal., 2009], who also proved, by geometric methods, a closely related property for the classical mean curvature under Minkowski interpolation of convex bodies.
